reference_sql:
WITH day_events AS (
  -- one row per session_start or sign_up event from 26 October to 1 November 2025
  SELECT event_date, event_name, device.category AS device_category, user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name IN ('session_start', 'sign_up')
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251026' AND '20251101'
)
SELECT event_date, device_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'session_start' THEN user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(ga_session_id AS VARCHAR) END) AS sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'sign_up') AS sign_ups
FROM day_events
GROUP BY event_date, device_category

WITH sessions AS (
  -- one row per day and device: the sessions that started
  SELECT event_date, device.category AS device_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS VARCHAR)) AS sessions
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251026' AND '20251101'
  GROUP BY event_date, device.category
), sign_ups AS (
  -- one row per day and device: the sign_up events
  SELECT event_date, device.category AS device_category, COUNT(*) AS sign_ups
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'sign_up'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251026' AND '20251101'
  GROUP BY event_date, device.category
)
SELECT COALESCE(s.event_date, u.event_date) AS event_date, COALESCE(s.device_category, u.device_category) AS device_category,
  COALESCE(s.sessions, 0) AS sessions, COALESCE(u.sign_ups, 0) AS sign_ups
FROM sessions AS s
FULL JOIN sign_ups AS u
  ON u.event_date = s.event_date AND u.device_category IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.device_category

WITH day_rows AS (
  -- one row per session (user_pseudo_id and ga_session_id), then one row per sign_up, from 26 October to 1 November 2025
  SELECT DISTINCT event_date, device.category AS device_category,
    user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST([p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'ga_session_id'][1] AS VARCHAR) AS session_key,
    0 AS sign_up
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251026' AND '20251101'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND [p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'ga_session_id'][1] IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT event_date, device.category, NULL, 1
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'sign_up'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251026' AND '20251101'
)
SELECT event_date, device_category, COUNT(session_key) AS sessions, SUM(sign_up) AS sign_ups
FROM day_rows
GROUP BY event_date, device_category

solver.query:
WITH ss AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT event_date, user_pseudo_id, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS sid, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'page_location')[1].value.string_value AS page_location, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS engaged, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_number')[1].value.int_value AS snum,
    traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, device.category AS device_category
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251026' AND '20251101'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value IS NOT NULL
),
s AS (SELECT event_date, device_category, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM ss GROUP BY 1, 2),
g AS (SELECT event_date, device.category AS device_category, COUNT(*) AS sign_ups FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'sign_up' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251026' AND '20251101' GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT COALESCE(s.event_date, g.event_date) AS event_date, COALESCE(s.device_category, g.device_category) AS device_category,
  COALESCE(s.sessions, 0) AS sessions, COALESCE(g.sign_ups, 0) AS sign_ups
FROM s FULL OUTER JOIN g ON s.event_date = g.event_date AND s.device_category IS NOT DISTINCT FROM g.device_category
